_comment: Copy to watcher.config.json. Every key is optional and every value below is the default, so this file behaves exactly like no file. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_discovery: Scan SwitchCreated logs from FROM_BLOCK (env) or fromBlock here on the first run (set it to the contract's deploy block); later runs resume from the state file, scanning the last 64 blocks again in case of a reorganisation (not on local Anvil); --rescan-from <block> scans again from there.
_confirmations: Optional "confirmations": blocks to stay behind the head while scanning (this only delays discovery; the 64-block re-scan is what survives deeper reorganisations). Unset = 0 on local Anvil, 2 elsewhere.
_switches: Optional "switches": extra switches to watch besides discovered ones, e.g. [{ "owner": "0x…", "id": "1" }]; quote the id (JSON numbers above 2^53 are rounded). Default: none.
_economics: Reveal only when bounty >= estimated gas x gas price x safetyFactor + minProfitEth (unless altruistic). revealGasEstimate is also the pre-check before asking the KMS.
_transactions: Wait this long for a receipt. A tx still pending on a later pass is replaced (same nonce, fees +12.5% or the market rate, capped by maxGasPriceGwei); a markDark / revealKey only while the bounty still pays at those fees. Otherwise it is left at its own fees, unless a later markDark / revealKey waits behind its nonce whose bounty also pays for freeing it: then a 0-value self-transfer frees the nonce and the action is given up.
_kms: Public decryption after markDark: per-request timeout, attempts per pass, a time budget per pass, then exponential backoff.
